# rachel: the world around the record

Everything here is fictional. It exists so the data has somewhere to come
from: routes explain repeated distances, the calendar explains gaps, people
explain context values. The generator draws from these constants, so the
record and this file agree by construction.

## Household and people

- Cork, Ireland. Semi-detached estate house with fourteen stairs.
- Husband Niall, 41, delivery planner. Walks with her on Sunday mornings
  when Fionn's match allows (those sessions carry `context: family`).
- Saoirse, 11, and Fionn, 7. School run by car, twice daily.
- Sister Aoife in Dublin: the occasional weekend visit, no scale there.
- Friend Deirdre from aqua fit: the reason she keeps going on the weeks she
  would rather not (`context: social` on Wednesdays).

## Body and build

162 cm. Baseline 121-123 kg (BMI about 46). Carries weight centrally; the
knees, not the heart, are the limiter. Right knee worse than left.

## Transport and routine

Drives everywhere by habit; the project of the record is exactly the
distances short enough to walk. Weekly shape: school runs Monday to Friday,
aqua fit Wednesday 19:00, big shop Friday after drop-off, kids' matches
Saturday morning, walk with Niall Sunday.

## Places

- **Grocery**: SuperValu, ten minutes' drive. Friday ritual.
- **Leisure centre**: Glenbrook Leisure Centre, concession-tier membership
  (aqua fit only; she has never used the gym floor and does not intend to).
- **Pool**: same centre; the Wednesday aqua-fitness class is her only
  water time.
- **GP surgery**: monthly review visits while the medication is titrated
  (these appear as medical visit rows, recorded after they happened).

## Route catalog

Real people repeat a small set of loops. Hers is a graduation ladder, and
her honest session durations climb it across the medicated months:

| Route | Distance | Shape | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| school gate | 0.7 km | out and back | the goal route; flat pavement |
| estate loop | 1.6 km | single loop | streetlit, safe in the dark |
| park loop | 3.1 km | single loop | gravel path, one gentle rise; bench at halfway |

The eleven inflated manual walk rows (LIES.md R1) all claim the park loop;
the phone tracks for the same walks show the estate loop distance. The lie
is in the duration AND the implied route.

## Calendar and milestones

- 2029-05-01: record starts (pre-medication baseline).
- 2030-02-03: medication starts (GP-initiated, athlete-stated row).
- Monthly GP review visits from February 2030.
- School terms shape the walking: school-gate walks happen on school days.
- Milestone she named: fourteen of fourteen stairs with the washing basket.
- Family fortnight in Kerry, late August, planned (outside the record span;
  she wants to walk to the beach cafe unaided, which is why the park loop
  matters to her now).
